notes.title: New Update Live - Version 2.0.1
notes.content:
[h1]Patch Update Notes - Version 2.0.1[/h1]

[list]
[*] Enhanced gameplay calculations for a smoother experience.
[*] Improved server stability to address failures.
[*] Refined matchmaking based on ELO for balanced games.
[*] Introduced Google, Blink, and Apple login options.
[*] Discounted prices on select in-game items.
[*] Fixed major bugs and UI issues.
[*] Streamlined level design to resolve gameplay stuck problems.
[*] Optimized gameplay for reduced latency.
[*] Minor bug fixes for improved overall stability.
[/list]

Thank you for your continued support!

notes.title: Build Note - Version 1.5.1 Update
notes.content:
Major Fixes:
[list]
[*]Cards Cooldown Issue: Resolved an issue where cards cooldown was not functioning as intended. Players should now experience consistent and accurate cooldown times for their cards during gameplay.
[*]Sync Issues: Addressed synchronization issues that were affecting gameplay. Players should notice improved synchronization across different game elements, providing a smoother and more seamless gaming experience.
[/list]
Minor Bug Fixes:
[list]
[*]Various minor bug fixes have been implemented to enhance overall game stability and performance.
[/list]
